title: Shrimp Ravioli with Italian Seasoning
description: A classic Italian-inspired dish featuring shrimp and ravioli. This recipe is easy to make and perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
ingredients.notes: Cook shrimp according to package instructions, then chop into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use to cook shrimp and ravioli

ingredients.name: 2 cloves garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Add to olive oil for flavor

ingredients.name: 1 teaspoon dried Italian seasoning
ingredients.notes: Add to olive oil for flavor

ingredients.name: Salt and pepper to taste
ingredients.notes: Season with salt and pepper before serving

ingredients.name: Nutty parmesan cheese (optional)
ingredients.notes: Sprinkle on top of dish for added flavor

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook ravioli according to package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Add cooked ravioli to the skillet and toss with shrimp and garlic.
Sprinkle with Italian seasoning and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with nutty parmesan cheese if desired.
